films.title: The Mouth of the Wolf
films.overview: Upon his release from prison, an ex-convict returns to his beloved city of Genoa, and to his lover.

films.title: Scarlet
films.overview: A French widower and WWI veteran returns home after the war to raise his newborn daughter.

films.title: Lost and Beautiful
films.overview: Pulcinella, a foolish servant, is sent from the depths of Mt. Vesuvius to present-day Campania to grant the last wish of poor shepherd Tommaso, who spent his whole life looking after a crumbling Bourbon estate: his mission is to save a young buffalo named Sarchiapone. Pulcinella takes the buffalo north and the two servants, man and beast, travel through a beautiful and lost Italy.

films.title: Martin Eden
films.overview: The tale of an individualist proletarian in a time marked by the rise of mass political movements. In early 20th-century Italy, illiterate sailor Martin Eden seeks fame as a writer while torn between the love of a bourgeois girl and allegiance to his social class.
